sentences.en: The strong yen was a fatal blow to the company.
sentences.zh: 日元升值对这家公司来说是一记致命打击。

sentences.en: This and many other causes led to the fatal outcome.
sentences.zh: 种种原因导致了这场灾难性的结局。

sentences.en: He had a fatal lack of ability to think logically.
sentences.zh: 他缺乏逻辑思考的能力是一个致命的缺陷。

senses.zh: 致命的，造成死亡的；灾难性的，毁灭性的；决定性的，关键的
